mission.objective: Add a shared Widget type and two consumers
mission.title: Widget type + two adapters
mission.task: Define a new shared `Widget` type in src/types/widget.ts, then build two adapters that consume and extend it: a render adapter and a persistence adapter. Both adapters need to add fields to the shared type as they go, so the type file stays a moving target until both land.

candidateNodes.title: Widget shared type
candidateNodes.task: Define the initial Widget type in src/types/widget.ts.
acceptance: Widget type compiles and exports cleanly

candidateNodes.title: Render adapter
candidateNodes.task: Implement the render adapter in src/adapters/widgetRenderAdapter.ts, extending Widget with render-only fields.
acceptance: render adapter renders a Widget end to end
added fields are additive, never break n1's shape

candidateNodes.title: Persistence adapter
candidateNodes.task: Implement the persistence adapter in src/adapters/widgetPersistAdapter.ts, extending Widget with storage-only fields.
acceptance: added fields are additive, never break n1's shape
